  • Method Details

    • getAllItemsAsync

      public CompletableFuture<List<Item>> getAllItemsAsync()
      Loads every menu item that has not been removed. Allergy info is not loaded and is left empty.
      Returns:
      future holding the items, newest first

    • addItemAsync

      public CompletableFuture<Item> addItemAsync(String name, double price, boolean seasonal)
      Adds an item to the menu. New items are always in stock.
      Parameters:
      name - required, cannot be blank
      price - must be greater than zero
      seasonal - whether to add the item to the Seasonal Menu category
      Returns:
      future holding the saved item, including its database-generated id

    • updateItemAsync

      public CompletableFuture<Item> updateItemAsync(Item item)
      Saves an item's name, price and in-stock flag. Allergy info is not changed.
      Parameters:
      item - the edited item; its id selects the row to update. Name cannot be blank and price must be greater than zero.
      Returns:
      future holding the updated item, or failing if no item has that id

    • validate

      private void validate(String name, double price)
      Validates an item's name and price.
      Parameters:
      name - the item's name, required, cannot be blank
      price - the item's price, must be greater than zero
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is blank or the price is not greater than zero

    • removeItemAsync

      public CompletableFuture<Void> removeItemAsync(long id)
      Hides an item from the menu. The row is kept in the database.
      Parameters:
      id - item id
      Returns:
      future that completes when the item is hidden, or fails if no item has that id

    • getItemsByCategoryAsync

      public CompletableFuture<List<Item>> getItemsByCategoryAsync(String category)
      Loads the items in a category, including their allergy info.
      Parameters:
      category - category name, matched exactly
      Returns:
      future holding the category's items, ordered by name
